title: Add Comicstyles to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Comicstyles](https://comicstyles.com) to image
- ComicStyles turns a one-line idea into a comic story, with no install, no account and no API key required. Type your premise, let the platform write the story and its split into panels, then watch eac

Fixes #14923

gist.headline: Panels join the garden
gist.blurb: ComicStyles has landed in the app garden. Bring a one-line premise; leave with a whole little comic, because apparently ideas enjoy becoming sequential art now.
gist.summary: Added ComicStyles to the Pollinations app directory, giving users a no-install, no-account, no-API-key tool that turns a one-line premise into a written, panel-split comic story.
gist.impact: Users can now discover ComicStyles through Pollinations and go from a short idea to a multi-panel comic without setup or credentials.
gist.visual_concept: Depict ComicStyles as a cozy comic-making desk: a one-line idea on a note blooms into several illustrated comic panels arranged like garden plots. Polli, wearing a tiny artist beret, helps place panels while a few code-flowers and vines grow around a retro drawing terminal, making the no-setup creative flow feel welcoming.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny painter's beret as she arranges a one-line idea into a row of charming comic panels on a retro drawing terminal; comic-panel garden plots, flowers, and code-vines bloom around her, with lime green (#ecf874) prominently glowing from the screen. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, simple pixel-font text: "ONE IDEA → COMIC", nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
